title: Dark Page Section
description: The dark warm-brown band the live site uses for its "Why choose Southern Destinations" footer CTA — neutral-800, base body copy, and accent-500 for the script accent headings and the section title's gold rule. On live this is `.footer-cta-section`, which paints a repeating watermark JPEG (`why-choose-sd-bg-img.jpg`) over the brown; the flat token is the starting point and the watermark is a separate decision, recorded in style.md. Vertical padding is preset 70, matching the 70px the live rule sets literally.
